definition: Tenable means able to be defended or maintained.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word tenable. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know tenable should be able to work it out from your sentence.

When the bookshop opened in 1998, its plan was simple: stock the classics, keep late hours, and let foot traffic do the rest.
For fifteen years the plan worked, and the owner waved away every warning about online retail.
By 2019 the numbers told a different story: rent had doubled, foot traffic had thinned, and the old plan was no longer tenable.
The owner did not close; she changed what she was defending.
Author nights, a coffee counter, and school partnerships now bring in half the revenue.
Asked about the shift, she shrugs: a position you cannot hold is not a strategy, it is a memory.
